I recently became a patient at the Soi 5 clinic. I needed some root canal treatment and a couple of new crowns. I had the misfortune to be introduced to a dentist who's name was elusive but seemed to be A or Eh.he didn't have a name card. The first few visits were fine and he seemed like a capable dentist but that all changed on my last visit where i suffered some of the most unprofessional behaviour I've ever experienced. During the treatment he was shouting and being generally obnoxious then,and here's the crux; he didn't complete the second part of that days treatment instead asking me to have it done elsewhere and not to return. He refused to say what the problem was so insisted he tell me and it transpired my 'crime' was to ask to look at the crown he was going to fit ? While at the time I was only being inquisitive and BTW if I did want to inspect it that would be my right;I later thought about it and now think maybe he did indeed have something to hide. Either way it was a thoroughly unpleasant experience and while his dental abilities are not in question I would recommend avoiding him at all costs. I believe he also works in several other clinics in the Jomtien area.

I asked the staff who seemed embarrassed by his behaviour what the problem was and they said 'he was tired'.
